title: Post Agent - publish video to YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook
description:
An agent that takes the final video and publishes it to social media platforms.

## What it does
1. Reads the video file and script (for caption/description text)
2. Generates platform-appropriate metadata:
   - YouTube: title, description, tags, thumbnail
   - LinkedIn: post text, video upload
   - Instagram: reel caption, hashtags
   - Facebook: post text, video upload
3. Posts to each platform

## Implementation approaches
- Cobrowser: navigate to each platform's upload page, fill forms, upload video
  - Pro: no API keys needed
  - Con: fragile, slow, login-dependent, may trigger anti-automation
- Platform APIs: YouTube Data API, LinkedIn API, Instagram Graph API, Facebook Graph API
  - Pro: reliable, fast
  - Con: OAuth setup, API key management, rate limits
- Hybrid: use APIs where available, cobrowser as fallback

## Key challenges
- Authentication: all platforms require login. Cobrowser would use existing browser sessions.
- Video upload: large files need reliable upload mechanism
- Platform-specific formatting: character limits, aspect ratios, hashtag strategies
- Scheduling: should posts go out simultaneously or staggered?

## Minimum viable version
- YouTube only via cobrowser (most valuable platform for financial content)
- Manual login in Firefox, agent uses existing session
- Upload video + set title/description/tags

## Dependencies
- Requires: Video Agent (Minerva-jxg)
- Requires: Cobrowser with active Firefox session logged into platforms

title: Supervisor Agent - orchestrate daily Mag 10 stock research at 1pm PST
description:
A supervisor/orchestrator agent that runs the daily stock research pipeline.

## What it does
1. Triggers daily at 1pm PST (timer trigger, interval_seconds=86400, or manually)
2. Defines the Magnificent 10 S&P stocks: AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, NVDA, META, BRK.B, TSLA, UNH, JPM
3. For each ticker, calls minerva_spawn_agent to invoke the "Stock Researcher" agent with the ticker as initial_message
4. Waits for all 10 to complete (needs CHAT_COMPLETED event triggers or polling)
5. Once all research is done, spawns the Script Writer agent with the collected research data

## Architecture questions to resolve
- How does the supervisor know when all 10 researchers are done? Options:
  a) CHAT_COMPLETED triggers that message back to supervisor (but anti-flood allows only 1 active per trigger)
  b) Supervisor polls the spreadsheet/notes for completeness
  c) Sequential spawning: supervisor spawns one at a time, waits for completion signal, then spawns next
- Cobrowser is single-tab — 10 sequential stock lookups will take ~5-10 minutes total
- Should the supervisor be a higher-capability model (Sonnet) while researchers stay on Haiku?

## Agent chaining pattern (from nudge)
- Agents chain via CHAT_COMPLETED event triggers
- TriggerDefinition: trigger_type=EVENT, event_type=CHAT_COMPLETED, watched_agent_ids=[researcher_id], agent_id=supervisor_id
- action_type=MESSAGE_EXISTING sends {last_response} back to supervisor
- Anti-flood: one active chat per trigger — may need multiple triggers or sequential approach

## Dependencies
- Requires: Stock Researcher Agent (Minerva-gqk)
- Blocks: Script Writer Agent, Video Pipeline

title: Agent skills system: reusable, composable task templates for agents
description: Agents currently get a system prompt and tool access, but have no concept of 'skills' — reusable task templates that encapsulate a multi-step workflow (e.g., 'scrape stock price from Yahoo Finance', 'find top Reddit post for a topic', 'summarize and compute sentiment'). Skills would be: (1) named, versioned task recipes with specific tool call sequences, (2) composable — an agent prompt can reference multiple skills, (3) parameterized — accept inputs like ticker symbol, URL, etc., (4) testable independently of the agent. Related to the stock-researcher agent design work where we're discovering that the system prompt needs very specific scraping instructions (URLs, CSS selectors, output formats) that would be better modularized as skills.

title: Script Writer Agent - turn stock research into short video script
description:
An agent that reads the completed stock research (from spreadsheet + notes tabs) and writes a short video script.

## What it does
1. Reads "Stock Tracker" spreadsheet for all 10 tickers' price/sentiment data
2. Reads each ticker's notes tab for detailed research (news, reddit, sentiment analysis)
3. Produces a concise, engaging video script (~60-90 seconds of narration) covering:
   - Market overview (how many bullish vs bearish vs neutral)
   - Top movers (biggest price changes)
   - Top story (most interesting news headline)
   - Social pulse (most interesting Reddit sentiment finding)
   - Closing takeaway
4. Outputs the script to a note or text editor for review

## Design considerations
- Script format: narration text with [VISUAL CUE] markers for the video agent
- Tone: professional but accessible (like a morning market brief)
- Should include visual direction hints: "[SHOW TICKER CHART]", "[HIGHLIGHT PRICE]", "[DISPLAY SENTIMENT GAUGE]"
- Model: probably Sonnet for better creative writing quality

## Enabled tools needed
minerva_get_spreadsheet_data, minerva_list_notes, minerva_get_note, minerva_create_note, minerva_create_text_editor, minerva_update_editor

## Dependencies

- Blocks: Video Agent

title: Reference: Minerva Agent System Architecture
description:
Knowledge reference for how the Minerva agent system works (as of 2026-02-12).

## Core Classes (src/Scripts/Services/Agents/)
- AgentDefinition.gd: Data class — id, name, system_prompt, provider_enum_id, core_service_id, core_action_name, temperature, top_p, frequency_penalty, presence_penalty, max_tool_call_rounds, enabled_tools[], memory_tab_name, drawer_tab_name
- AgentRegistry.gd: Persistent CRUD at user://agent_registry.json. add/update/remove/get_agent, get_agent_by_name
- AgentSpawner.gd: Static. spawn_agent(agent_def, initial_message, trigger_id) → ChatHistory. Creates provider, sets DisabledTools from allowlist, creates memory tabs, renders in ChatPane
- TriggerManager.gd: Node on SingletonObject. Timer + event triggers with anti-flood (1 active chat per trigger)

## Provider enum IDs
HUMAN=0, NEMOTRON_NANO=1, DEVSTRAL_SMALL=2, GPT_NANO=3, GPT_STANDARD=4, GPT_DEEP=5, GEMINI_FLASH=7, GEMINI_PRO=8, CLAUDE_HAIKU=10, CLAUDE_SONNET=11, CLAUDE_OPUS=12, TURNROCK=13, CLAUDE_CODE_SONNET=18, CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS=19. OpenRouter >= 1000.

## MCP Tools for agents
- minerva_list_agents: no args → {agents[], count}
- minerva_create_agent: name, system_prompt, provider_enum_id required → {agent_id}
- minerva_update_agent: agent_id required, all other fields optional
- minerva_delete_agent: agent_id → {message}
- minerva_spawn_agent: agent_id OR agent_name, optional initial_message → {chat_id, agent_name, agent_id}

## Trigger System
- TriggerDefinition: trigger_type (TIMER=0, EVENT=1), event_type (NOTE_CREATED=0, NOTE_CHANGED=1, CHAT_COMPLETED=2), action_type (SPAWN_NEW=0, MESSAGE_EXISTING=1)
- Template vars in initial_message: {agent_name}, {last_response}, {history_name}
- Anti-flood: one active chat per trigger, skips if previous still running
- Triggers serialized per-project (NOT in agent_registry.json)

## Agent Chaining
- Agent A completes → CHAT_COMPLETED trigger fires → spawns/messages Agent B
- Supervisor pattern: supervisor spawns sub-agents via minerva_spawn_agent, CHAT_COMPLETED trigger on sub-agents messages supervisor back via MESSAGE_EXISTING
- watched_agent_ids filters which agent completions fire the trigger

## Signals
- SingletonObject.chat_completed(response: BotResponse) — fires per response
- SingletonObject.agent_chat_finished(history_id, agent_definition_id) — fires once when agent truly done (ChatPane.gd line 1035-1036)

## Memory Tabs
- memory_tab_name: project-scoped notes tab, auto-created and linked to chat on spawn
- drawer_tab_name: app-scoped drawer notes tab, persists across projects
- Both auto-link via default_linked_chat_ids so notes appear in agent's context

## Key Lessons from Stock Researcher development
- LLMs hallucinate dates: always call minerva_clock first
- cobrowser_read with selector "body" returns 500K+ chars — always use specific selectors
- old.reddit.com required — new reddit shadow DOM invisible to cobrowser
- minerva_add_spreadsheet_row appends to grid end (row 100), use update_spreadsheet_data with cell refs instead
- cobrowser_query_all truncates text, cobrowser_read with index gives full text
- Agent enabled_tools is an allowlist (empty = all tools). Tools NOT in the list get added to DisabledTools.

Stock Researcher Agent - tested and working v1
description:
Working stock research agent registered in Minerva (agent_id: 081eb8f293b9f3a3, name: "Stock Researcher", provider: CLAUDE_HAIKU enum 10, temp 0.3, max_tool_call_rounds 25).

## What it does
Given any ticker (e.g., "NVDA") or company name (e.g., "look up nvidia"), the agent:
1. Calls minerva_clock to get current date (YYYY-MM-DD)
2. Scrapes Yahoo Finance for previous closing price
3. Scrapes Google News for top headline
4. Scrapes old.reddit.com for 30 recent posts, scores sentiment (bullish/bearish/neutral with -1.0 to +1.0 score)
5. Clicks into the most substantive Reddit post to read actual content (~500 chars)
6. Writes price row to "Stock Tracker" spreadsheet (Date, Ticker, Company, Previous Close, Change %, Sentiment, Score)
7. Creates "{TICKER}" notes tab with formatted research note including price, news, sentiment breakdown, notable post quote, and analysis

## Enabled tools
cobrowser_navigate, cobrowser_read, cobrowser_query_all, cobrowser_get_page_info, cobrowser_click, minerva_create_spreadsheet_editor, minerva_get_spreadsheet_data, minerva_update_spreadsheet_data, minerva_list_editors, minerva_create_note, minerva_create_note_tab, minerva_update_note, minerva_list_notes, minerva_get_note, minerva_clock

## Tested CSS selectors (verified 2026-02-12)
- Yahoo Finance: [data-field="regularMarketPreviousClose"], [data-testid="qsp-price-change-percent"], h1 index 1
- Google News: a.JtKRv (headline), .vr1PYe (source), time.hvbAAd (timestamp)
- Reddit (MUST use old.reddit.com): .search-result-link .search-title, .search-score, .search-subreddit-link, .search-comments, .search-time. Post body: .usertext-body

## Key design decisions
- Uses cobrowser_read with specific selectors + index (NOT cobrowser_read body which is 500K+ chars)
- Reddit: old.reddit.com only (new reddit shadow DOM invisible to cobrowser)
- Sentiment: LLM classifies each of 30 post titles, computes aggregate score
- Spreadsheet: reads existing data via get_spreadsheet_data to find next row, writes via update_spreadsheet_data with cell references (NOT add_spreadsheet_row which appends to grid end)
- Date: must call minerva_clock first — LLMs hallucinate dates

title: Video Agent - create animated short video from script
description:
An agent that takes the video script and produces an animated short video.

## What it does
1. Reads the video script (with [VISUAL CUE] markers)
2. Creates video segments using available tools:
   - Blender: 3D animated charts, ticker displays, transitions
   - Godot: 2D motion graphics, text animations, sentiment gauges
   - Video AI tools: background generation, stock footage, talking head
3. Assembles segments into a final video with narration
4. Exports to standard format (MP4)

## Major unknowns / research needed
- What video creation tools are accessible via MCP? Options:
  a) Minerva's VideoRecorder/VideoExporter (ffmpeg wrapper, already in codebase)
  b) Blender Python API via CodeTools bash
  c) Godot scene generation (Minerva IS a Godot app)
  d) External AI video APIs (Runway, Pika, etc.) via cobrowser or API calls
  e) Graphics editor in Minerva for static frames → combine into video
- TTS for narration: ElevenLabs API? Local TTS? Minerva's AudioToText is input-only.
- This is the hardest agent in the pipeline — may need to start with simple slideshow + TTS

## Minimum viable version
- Generate static frames using Minerva graphics editor (one per script segment)
- Use ffmpeg (via CodeTools bash) to combine frames + TTS audio into video
- No 3D animation in v1

## Dependencies
- Requires: Script Writer Agent (Minerva-8ul)
- Requires: CodeTools sandbox (Minerva-snf) for ffmpeg/blender execution
- Blocks: Post Agent

title: Cobrowser multi-tab support for parallel agent execution
description:
Enable the cobrowser (HumanWeb Firefox extension) to support multiple tabs simultaneously, each with its own session ID, so different Minerva agents can operate on different browser tabs in parallel.

## Current Bottleneck (3 places)

1. Extension (background.js): forwardCommandToActiveTab() always queries browser.tabs.query({active: true}) instead of routing to a specific tab by ID.
2. Service (cobrowser_service.py line 1554-1570): Always picks active_sessions[0] instead of routing by tab/session ID.
3. MCP tools: No tab_id parameter to specify which tab a command targets.

## What Already Exists (unused)
- SessionManager.tabSessions map (tabId to sessionId) — defined, never populated
- SessionManager.setActiveTab() — defined, never called
- Content scripts injected in ALL tabs via all_urls match
- browser.tabs.sendMessage(tabId, message) can target any specific tab
- Extension has tabs permission in manifest.json

## Proposed Design (Single WebSocket, Multiplexed)

### Extension changes (background.js, session-manager.js):
1. On command.navigate, open a NEW tab instead of navigating current one
2. Record tabId to sessionId in existing tabSessions map via setActiveTab()
3. Route commands to specific tab via browser.tabs.sendMessage(tabId, msg) instead of querying active tab
4. Return tab_id in navigate response so caller can track it

### Service changes (cobrowser_service.py):
1. Add optional tab_id to command envelope
2. Route to correct cobrowser session based on tab mapping
3. Fall back to active_sessions[0] if no tab_id specified (backwards compat)

### Minerva MCP changes (MinervaMCPServer.gd):
1. Add optional tab_id parameter to all cobrowser MCP tools
2. Each agent gets assigned a tab_id when it first navigates
3. Agent passes its tab_id on all subsequent cobrowser commands

## Code Files to Modify
1. ~/github/HumanWeb/src/extension-cobrowser/background/background.js
2. ~/github/HumanWeb/src/extension-cobrowser/background/session-manager.js
3. ~/github/HumanWeb/src/Library/cobrowser_service.py
4. ~/github/Minerva/src/Scripts/Services/MCP/MinervaMCPServer.gd

## Notes
- Stock Researcher agent should remain SEQUENTIAL even with multi-tab, to avoid anti-scrape detection from Reddit and Yahoo Finance
- Multi-tab is for running DIFFERENT agents in parallel (e.g., Stock Researcher on Yahoo while Script Writer reads data)
- Infrastructure is ~80% there — mostly wiring up existing unused code
